responsibility: Implements the compiler’s dictionary of named search paths as a linked list of `NamedPath` records, each pairing a symbolic path name with a `DynamicPath.PathList`. It distinguishes anonymous user include directories from named system paths, appends new directories to the appropriate entry, supports concatenation and ownership transfer of named-path lists, searches the dictionary with `DynamicPath.FindFileName` to return a full pathname and matched path name, and provides debugging dumps of the current path configuration used by source/module lookup code.
same_name_distinction: This implementation module provides the concrete named-path dictionary behavior declared in PathName.def; unlike the .def file, it defines the NamedPath record layout and implements list management, path insertion, lookup, and debugging dumps.
